production_backend.notes: Retain read-only deployed Worker version, exact worker/module/schema identity, production Clerk binding names/readiness without secret values, and non-mutating route/configuration observations. Local prepared_not_deployed receipt alone is insufficient. Do not create synthetic production accounts or scores.

native_signin_cancel_refresh_signout.notes: Observe the secure native production sign-in sheet and cancellation with the authorized existing session; record simulator/device, OS and source identity. Verify error/retry, token refresh and sign-out through isolated native-client integration. Label which steps were live UI versus isolated fixtures; do not create synthetic production accounts or claim a production identity flow that was not observed.

scores_and_private_alias.notes: Against the exact frozen Worker/modules/schema in isolated real D1, verify score submission and explicit Post Local Best, board readback, chosen alias/default Penguin and private social-name/email separation. Pair with native-client/UI integration. No synthetic production scores or accounts.

cloud_save_roundtrip.notes: Against the exact frozen Worker/modules/schema in isolated real D1, verify authenticated save upload/read/restore, revision handling, concurrent writes and account isolation. Pair with native-client transport/retry integration. Preserve real user saves; no synthetic production accounts or save writes.

account_deletion_and_write_fence.notes: Against the exact frozen Worker/modules/schema in isolated real D1, verify profile/scores/save removal, old-write fence, retained receipt/status, interrupted-status recovery and account isolation. Pair with native-client integration proving local earned progress remains. Simulate identity-provider success/failure and label that evidence. No production account deletion; this check does not claim live provider deletion or retained-record cleanup complete.

offline_guest_and_no_payments.notes: Verify guest startup/play/local save without account login, sign-out behavior, and absence of native purchase/restore entry points in this account-enabled iOS artifact.

account_data_inventory.notes: Record actual production Clerk providers/scopes and identity fields, game payload fields, host/provider network/security processing, retention, public-name separation, and matching public policy scope. Do not mark the historical offline inventory current.

validation_scope.production: Native production sign-in/cancel UI plus read-only deployment/configuration observations. No synthetic production accounts, scores, saves, or destructive account tests.
validation_scope.account_behavior: Exact frozen Worker/modules/schema in isolated real D1, paired with native-client integration. Provider deletion responses are simulated and clearly labelled.
validation_scope.limits: This acceptance does not observe live production deletion or prove complete provider/retained-record erasure. Permanent deletion of a real account requires explicit user action and confirmation.
